about: The application object (App, built on BaseApp): its first field is App's vtable (dx11 +0x5499F58: +0x98 App::InitApp, +0xA8 App::LoadAndResaveGraphicsSettings, +0xB0 App::InitGame). Script Extender calls it AppInstance.

evidence.says: live, copy attacks: Ext.Debug.GetSymbolAddress('AppInstance') - module base = code:BaseApp::s_AppInstance; ReadValue of it, then of its first field, gave the vtable whose slots are named in about

questions.ask: Who writes it: dx11 code:BaseApp::BaseApp stores this at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x6046F98, not here; a read of the store at code:BaseApp::s_AppInstance (Script Extender's AppInstance mapping) would confirm the name
